title: claudex verification artifact, version 1
description: The final acceptance check: each acceptance criterion with its evidence, any scope expansion, whether tests are meaningful, unsupported claims, an overall pass/fail verdict, and notes. Submitted for a verify phase.

protocol_version.description: The protocol major version; always 1 for this schema.

message_type.description: Discriminates this message from other protocol messages.

turn_id.description: The turn this verification is submitted for.

state_revision.description: The run-state revision this submit must compare-and-swap against.

human_context.description: Optional free-text context for the human; null when none.

requires_human_decision.description: True only when an unresolved choice must escalate to the human.

decision_question.description: The concrete question for the human, else null.

criteria.description: Each acceptance criterion with whether it is met and its evidence.

evidence.description: Concrete file/test evidence, not agent testimony.

scope_expansion.description: Work done beyond the agreed scope.

tests_meaningful.description: Whether the tests actually exercise the acceptance criteria.
